description: Simulate geometric declining Drip Vault emission and ApexRevenueSplit (50% 3x/day USDC faucet + 50% buyback) UBI coverage benchmarks against live APEX ecosystem telemetry. Not advice. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

annualDecayPct.description: annual geometric drip decay percent (0.1 to 99, default 18.25)

dailyRevenueUsd.description: gross daily ecosystem/x402 revenue in USD (0.01 to 10000000)

faucetSharePct.description: percent allocated to 3x/day faucet claims (1 to 100, default 50)

horizonDays.description: simulation horizon in days (1 to 3650, default 365)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

vaultApex.description: starting Drip Vault tokens (default 50000000 APEX floor)
